content: yfinance is an unofficial Yahoo scraper with no published rate limits; Yahoo throttles under load returning 429/YFRateLimitError and can temporarily IP-block. Community-reported mitigation: bulk yf.download() over per-ticker loops, tenacity exponential backoff with retry on 429/connection errors, realistic User-Agent, and aggressive caching. yfinance maintainer explicitly recommends the yfinance-cache wrapper library to 'fetch smarter' and stop hammering Yahoo. No official documented recovery window (reports range ~1hr to 24hr+).
